# CLI: Pricing

## estimate

Kind: Read.

Provide a JSON setup object inline or in a regular file of at most 1 MiB. Input
fields use exact Go names. Explicit flags override `AllowPartial` and
`MaxRequests`.

Each group needs a unique `Key` and `Quantity` from 1 to 1000. A setup allows
1000 groups and 10000 summed units. Servers require explicit zone, flavor,
image, root disk type and size. Explicit disabled catalog zones can be quoted.
Supported server prices use unlicensed Ubuntu. Additional volumes are counted
independently.

Public IP groups use `Kind` and, for `public-vip`, an explicit `Type` (public,
public-vm or public-mkp). Unknown products retain unknown prices. Storage groups
use an exact catalog `Type`, `QuotaGB` and an optional catalog `Region` name or
ID. The configured region defaults to HCM04 for hcm-3 and HAN02 for han-1.

`DataDiskSize` and `DataDiskTypeID` add one disk per server unit. An optional
volume `ServerKey` must reference a server in the same zone. An associated
encrypted volume requires an encrypted server root. Encryption fields take the
catalog's encryption type identifiers.

Example `setup.json` with synthetic selectors:

```json
{
  "Servers": [
    {
      "Key": "web",
      "Quantity": 2,
      "ZoneID": "zone-1",
      "FlavorID": "flavor-1",
      "ImageID": "image-1",
      "RootDiskSize": 20,
      "RootDiskTypeID": "type-1"
    }
  ],
  "Volumes": [
    {
      "Key": "extra",
      "Quantity": 3,
      "ServerKey": "web",
      "ZoneID": "zone-1",
      "VolumeTypeID": "type-1",
      "Size": 10
    }
  ],
  "PublicIPs": [{ "Key": "ip", "Kind": "floating-ip", "Quantity": 2 }],
  "Storage": [
    { "Key": "objects", "Quantity": 1, "Type": "Gold", "QuotaGB": 30 }
  ]
}
```

The estimate covers specified recurring components only. Amounts are in VND,
with VAT as returned. `RequestedMonthlyTotal` is unknown unless every requested
group has a quote. Table, text and queries print coverage and pricing caveats on
stderr.

`--allow-partial` prints surviving results and returns exit 1 when processing
fails. The request budget defaults to 500 and accepts 1 through 2000 logical
requests. The invocation has a ten-minute deadline.

| Flag                                      | Type                         | Required |
| ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------- |
| `--max-requests`                          | `int`                        |          |
| `--allow-partial`                         | `bool`                       |          |
| `Servers` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `[]pricing.EstimateServer`   |          |
| `Volumes` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `[]pricing.EstimateVolume`   |          |
| `PublicIPs` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `[]pricing.EstimatePublicIP` |          |
| `Storage` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `[]pricing.EstimateStorage`  |          |

```sh
greennode pricing estimate --cli-input-json file://setup.json --allow-partial --max-requests 100 --output table
```

## get-quote

Kind: Read.

Prices are VND totals that include VAT. The API gives no VAT breakdown. For
vMonitor, use the monitor service's quote commands.

Empty `--action` sends `create`. Only exact `--action resize` accepts a negative
`OptimumPrice`. A negative amount is the expected credit in VND for the
remaining period. Zero is a valid quote.

Responses are limited to 1 MiB. Quote requests refuse redirects. Malformed
successful replies return `InvalidResponse` with the observed HTTP status.

| Flag                                         | Type             | Required |
| -------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------- |
| `--resource-type`                            | `string`         | yes      |
| `--action`                                   | `string`         |          |
| `ResourceInfo` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `map[string]any` |          |

```sh
greennode pricing get-quote --resource-type <resource-type>
```
